name: dashboard-sidebar
title: Dashboard with sidebar
description: A products dashboard with a sidebar navigation and a main content area. The dashboard has a header with a search input and a user menu. The sidebar has a logo, navigation links, and a card with a call to action. The main content area shows an empty state with a call to action.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AccountMenuEntry, NavLink } from '../data';
import MobileNav from './MobileNav.vue';
import SearchForm from './SearchForm.vue';
import UserMenu from './UserMenu.vue';

defineProps<{
  brandName: string;
  brandHref: string;
  links: NavLink[];
  navigationLabel: string;
  searchPlaceholder: string;
  menuEntries: AccountMenuEntry[];
  userMenuLabel: string;
  upgradeTitle: string;
  upgradeDescription: string;
  upgradeActionLabel: string;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <header class="flex h-14 items-center gap-4 border-b bg-muted/40 px-4 lg:h-[60px] lg:px-6">
    <MobileNav
      :brand-name="brandName"
      :brand-href="brandHref"
      :links="links"
      :navigation-label="navigationLabel"
      :upgrade-title="upgradeTitle"
      :upgrade-description="upgradeDescription"
      :upgrade-action-label="upgradeActionLabel"
    />
    <SearchForm :placeholder="searchPlaceholder" />
    <UserMenu
      :entries="menuEntries"
      :trigger-label="userMenuLabel"
    />
  </header>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';

withDefaults(defineProps<{
  title: string;
  description: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}>(), {
  compact: false,
});
</script>

<template>
  <Card>
    <CardHeader :class="compact ? 'p-2 pt-0 md:p-4' : undefined">
      <CardTitle>{{ title }}</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>
        {{ description }}
      </CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent :class="compact ? 'p-2 pt-0 md:p-4 md:pt-0' : undefined">
      <Button
        size="sm"
        class="w-full"
      >
        {{ actionLabel }}
      </Button>
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
</template>
